events.big-mom-introduced: First on-screen appearance of the Emperor Big Mom in Totto Land.
events.luffy-vs-cracker: Luffy battles for hours against Charlotte Cracker and his biscuit soldiers.
events.gear-4-tankman: After stuffing himself with biscuits, Luffy activates Gear Fourth Tankman and defeats Cracker.
events.luffy-vs-sanji: Sanji beats Luffy to drive him away; Luffy refuses to defend himself and promises to wait for him.
events.pudding-third-eye-revealed: Pudding reveals her third eye and the plan to assassinate the Vinsmokes at the wedding.
events.sanji-past-revealed: Flashback to Sanji's childhood in Germa and the sacrifice of his mother Sora.
events.luffy-waits-sanji-returns: Sanji comes back to the meeting point and returns with Luffy.
events.jinbe-leaves-big-mom-pirates: Jinbe returns his sake cup to Big Mom and leaves her crew.
events.tea-party-assassination-attempt: Mother Carmel's portrait is broken and Big Mom loses control during the tea party.
events.germa-66-transform: The Vinsmokes put on their raid suits and rescue Luffy's alliance.
events.big-mom-backstory: Linlin's past on Elbaph and the disappearance of Mother Carmel.
events.pedro-sacrifice: Pedro blows himself up to clear the way for the Thousand Sunny.
events.luffy-vs-katakuri: The duel between Luffy and Katakuri begins in the Mirro-World.
events.katakuri-awakening: Katakuri awakens his Mochi Mochi no Mi.
events.carrot-sulong: Carrot takes on her Sulong form under the full moon.
events.luffy-future-sight-observation-haki: Luffy attains the Observation Haki that sees the immediate future.
events.gear-4-snakeman: Luffy debuts Gear Fourth Snakeman, a speed form with punches whose path keeps changing.
events.luffy-defeats-katakuri: Luffy defeats Katakuri, who acknowledges his own defeat.
events.sanji-cake-calms-big-mom: Sanji and Pudding's cake cures Big Mom's hunger pangs.
events.jinbe-holds-back-big-mom: Jinbe and the Sun Pirates cover the Sunny's escape.
